map.UPDRS运动检查部分(Part III)是评估帕金森病运动症状的核心量表，14: The motor section of UPDRS (Part III) is the core scale for assessing motor symptoms of Parkinson's disease, with 14 items scored 0-4 each and a total of 0-56 points. It should be assessed separately in the 'on' and 'off' phases of medication.

map.56 分制，越高运动障碍越重。: 56-point scale, higher means more severe motor impairment.
